data.action: 站在理发台前细心擦拭整理剪刀与梳子
data.description: 【澄闪 · 理发沙龙前台】罗德岛阳光温暖的生活区理发小店内，粉发粉耳的菲林少女苏茜正站在明亮的梳妆台前，极其细心地用软布擦拭整理着各式锋利的剪刀与梳子。看到你推门进来，她头顶毛茸茸的猫耳敏锐地抖了抖，绽放出甜美治愈的微笑——「博士！欢迎光临苏茜的理发屋！今天想剪一个什么样的新发型呢？」
data.promptProse: Goldenglow carefully wipes and arranges scissors and combs at the bright salon station before looking up to welcome the next customer. Pink-and-white striped shirt, sage work apron and high twin ponytails with cat-paw scrunchies retain the stylist outfit beside folding pink ears. The medium view includes the tool tray and stations extending behind. Warm salon sunlight catches scissor blades and comb teeth, casting small precise shadows over the clean work surface.
data.title: 澄闪 · 理发沙龙前台
